properties.entry: SELECT C.CATEGORY_NAME, NVL(SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN GROUP_CATEGORIES C ON T.GCATEGORY_NUM = C.GCATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.GROUP_NUM IN ( SELECT GROUP_NUM FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' ) AND TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY C.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS TARGET_MONTH, NVL(SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T WHERE T.GROUP_NUM IN ( SELECT GROUP_NUM FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' ) AND T.TRANS_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM'), -5) AND T.TRANS_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM'), 1) AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY TARGET_MONTH
